metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods reviewed for safety and privacy, each locked to the exact version that was reviewed. See reviews/ for each report.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Keeps the 1-hour prompt cache warm during breaks and stops a cold send once with its estimated cost. Pings cost tokens. Reviewed 2026-10-15, see reviews/cache-tax.md.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar above the prompt and an Agents panel (/agents-info) showing subagents with model, cost and time. Reviewed 2026-10-15, see reviews/savvy-progress.md.
